# Weekly Madrid Meal Plan for 3 on €110

A realistic, budget-aware plan for a Madrid household of 3 with one vegetarian eater, one gluten-free eater, weekday dinners capped at 30 minutes, and planned leftovers for lunch at least 3 days. I’m assuming a standard kitchen, access to common Spanish supermarkets, and that lunch leftovers are for the next day.

## 7-Day Meal Plan with Leftovers Built In

| Day | Breakfast | Lunch | Dinner | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon | Yogurt, fruit, oats | Leftover Sunday prep bowl | Chickpea & spinach tomato stew with rice | Make extra for Tue lunch |
| Tue | Toast, tomato, olive oil, fruit | Leftover chickpea stew | Chicken tray-bake with potatoes, carrots, onions | GF by default; vegetarian swap uses halloumi |
| Wed | Eggs, fruit, yogurt | Leftover tray-bake plate | Lentil bolognese over gluten-free pasta | Make extra for Thu lunch |
| Thu | Overnight oats with banana | Leftover lentil pasta | Spanish tortilla with salad | Vegetarian and GF |
| Fri | Yogurt bowl with nuts | Leftover tortilla + salad | Fish, roasted vegetables, and rice | Quick oven meal |
| Sat | Toast, cheese, fruit | Chickpea salad wraps / corn tortillas | Veggie fajita bowls with beans, peppers, rice | Easy family meal |
| Sun | Brunch-style eggs, fruit, toast | Light leftovers / salad | Roast chicken, vegetables, and potatoes | Cook extra for Mon lunch |

## Main Dinners and Simple Recipes

### Monday: Chickpea & Spinach Tomato Stew
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Time:** 20–25 min
- **Serves:** 3 with leftovers
- **Ingredients:** 2 cans chickpeas, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 can crushed tomato, spinach, paprika, cumin, olive oil, rice
- **Method:** Sauté onion and garlic; add spices and tomatoes; stir in chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes; fold in spinach; serve with rice.
- **Leftovers:** Save 1–2 portions for Tuesday lunch.

### Tuesday: Chicken Tray-Bake or Halloumi Tray-Bake
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg-fried.svg
- **Time:** 10 min prep, 25 min oven
- **Ingredients:** Chicken thighs, potatoes, carrots, onion, olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary
- **Vegetarian swap:** Halloumi or extra chickpeas instead of chicken
- **Method:** Toss everything with oil and seasoning; roast at 200°C until cooked through.
- **Leftovers:** Pack extra vegetables and protein for lunch if any remain.

### Wednesday: Lentil Bolognese
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/flower1.svg
- **Time:** 25–30 min
- **Ingredients:** Lentils, onion, carrot, garlic, tomato passata, Italian herbs, gluten-free pasta
- **Method:** Cook pasta; simmer onion, carrot, garlic, lentils, passata, and herbs until thick; serve over pasta.
- **Leftovers:** Keep 1–2 portions for Thursday lunch.

### Thursday: Spanish Tortilla with Salad
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg.svg
- **Time:** 25–30 min
- **Ingredients:** Potatoes, eggs, onion, olive oil, lettuce, tomato, cucumber
- **Method:** Pan-cook thin potato and onion slices until soft; mix with beaten eggs; cook gently until set.
- **GF note:** Naturally gluten-free and vegetarian.
- **Leftovers:** Great cold for lunch.

### Friday: Fish with Roasted Vegetables and Rice
- **Time:** 25–30 min
- **Ingredients:** White fish fillets, zucchini, peppers, onion, rice, lemon
- **Method:** Roast vegetables while rice cooks; pan-sear or oven-bake fish with lemon and olive oil.
- **GF note:** Naturally gluten-free.

### Saturday: Veggie Fajita Bowls
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/basket.svg
- **Time:** 25 min
- **Ingredients:** Bell peppers, onion, black beans, rice, avocado, yogurt, spices
- **Method:** Sauté peppers and onion with paprika and cumin; warm beans; serve over rice with yogurt or avocado.
- **GF note:** Serve as bowls or with corn tortillas.

### Sunday: Roast Chicken, Vegetables, and Potatoes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Time:** 15 min prep, 60 min roast
- **Ingredients:** Whole chicken, potatoes, carrots, onions, garlic, olive oil, herbs
- **Method:** Roast everything together; carve for dinner and reserve leftovers for Monday lunch.
- **Vegetarian backup:** Roast a separate tray of chickpeas, peppers, and cauliflower for the vegetarian plate.

## Shopping List for the Week

### Produce
- Potatoes, 4 kg
- Onions, 1.5 kg
- Garlic, 2 bulbs
- Carrots, 1 kg
- Bell peppers, 6
- Spinach, 2 bags
- Tomatoes, 8–10
- Cucumber, 1
- Lettuce or mixed salad greens, 2 heads/bags
- Zucchini, 3
- Avocados, 2
- Bananas, 7
- Apples or oranges, 10–12
- Lemons, 3

### Protein and Dairy
- Eggs, 24
- Chickpeas, 4 cans
- Lentils, 500 g dry or 3 cans
- White fish fillets, 500–600 g
- Chicken thighs, 1.2–1.5 kg
- Whole chicken, 1.5–1.8 kg
- Yogurt, 1.5–2 kg
- Halloumi, 1 block
- Cheese for breakfast/snacks, 1 block

### Pantry and Grains
- Rice, 2 kg
- Gluten-free pasta, 2 packs
- Gluten-free oats, 1 large bag
- Corn tortillas, 1–2 packs
- Passata or crushed tomatoes, 4 cartons/cans
- Olive oil
- Paprika
- Cumin
- Dried oregano or mixed herbs
- Salt and pepper
- Nuts or seeds, 1 bag

### Estimated Budget Split
- Produce: €28–35
- Protein/dairy: €40–48
- Pantry/grains: €20–25
- Extras/snacks: €8–12
- **Total target:** about **€96–110**

## Sunday Evening Prep Schedule

### 18:00–18:15: Wash and chop
- Wash salad greens, spinach, peppers, carrots, and cucumbers
- Chop onions, carrots, and peppers for Monday to Wednesday
- Store in labeled containers

### 18:15–18:35: Batch-cook basics
- Cook a large pot of rice
- Boil or roast extra potatoes
- Make one pot of chickpea stew base for Monday dinner

### 18:35–18:55: Protein prep
- Marinate chicken for Tuesday or Sunday roast
- Rinse lentils and measure pasta portions
- Hard-boil 6 eggs for breakfasts and lunches

### 18:55–19:15: Lunch boxes
- Portion Monday and Tuesday leftovers into containers
- Pack salad components separately so they stay fresh
- Label anything that should be used within 2 days

### 19:15–19:30: Breakfast setup
- Portion oats into jars
- Wash fruit and place it where it’s easy to grab
- Set out yogurt, nuts, and bread for quick weekday breakfasts

## Budget and Practical Tips

- Buy **seasonal produce** from local markets for the best value.
- Use **rice, potatoes, lentils, and chickpeas** as the main budget staples.
- Keep meals **naturally gluten-free** where possible to avoid making separate dishes.
- Cook **double portions** on Monday, Wednesday, and Sunday to guarantee leftover lunches.
- Use the vegetarian eater’s plate as the base meal, then add chicken or fish only to the non-vegetarian portions.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Gluten-free pantry list](https://www.google.com/search?q=gluten+free+pantry+shopping+list+Spain)
